q: Exponential families p(x;θ) = h(x)exp(θ·T(x) - A(θ)) are geometrically special because:
opts: They form flat manifolds with respect to the e-connection (exponential connection) and the m-connection (mixture connection)
exp: Exponential families are e-flat (flat in the exponential/information geometry sense). The natural parameters θ form an e-affine coordinate system; the mean parameters η=E[T(X)]=∇A(θ) form an m-affine system. The two connections are dual, enabling elegant geometry (Pythagorean theorem for KL divergence).
